title: LearnWorlds Review (2026)
intro: LearnWorlds is evaluated here as Marketing & Growth software — LearnWorlds is an AI-powered learning management system for course creators, training providers, and academies — combining course building, commerce (checkouts, memberships, funnels), community, certificates/SCORM, marketing integrations, and learner analytics. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s marketing methodology (ease of use, campaign/content tools, marketing automation, funnel/conversion, analytics, brand monitoring, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose LearnWorlds when an AI-powered LMS with built-in course commerce and academy delivery is the primary job — especially for creators and training providers.
verdict: Choose LearnWorlds when an AI-powered LMS with built-in course commerce and academy delivery is the primary job — especially for creators and training providers. Compare Kartra for broader creator funnels/email/SMS all-in-one, Freshmarketer for Freshworks marketing automation, and SocialBee if social scheduling is the primary need. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: LearnWorlds positions templates and AI course building for learning businesses — approachable for creators, with academy depth adding setup complexity on higher tiers.
Landing pages, page funnels with AI, coupons, and course sales pages are first-party strengths for course GTM — not a social calendar tool.
Learning Center documents triggers/conditions/delays; Starter/Pro cover selling and some email credits — solid LMS automation, not full multichannel MA.
Commerce engine (checkouts, memberships, upsells, page funnels) is core to the product story — high score for course conversion workflows.
Course, sales, affiliate, and learner reporting with scheduled reports on higher tiers; not enterprise multi-touch marketing attribution.
Not a social listening product — low score by design versus Brand24-class tools.
50+ built-in integrations marketed (Stripe, PayPal, HubSpot, Zapier, Mailchimp, Shopify, live session tools) — strong LMS ecosystem connectivity.
Published path from Starter → Corporate custom learners/admins; multi-client groups on Learning Center — solid for growing academies.
Starter at $29/mo is accessible but enrollment fees and learner/AI caps push upgrades; Pro Trainer removes enrollment fees — mid-strong value excluding affiliate terms.
AI course builder, assessments, emails/images, interactive video AI, and metered AI credits are marketed core features.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: LearnWorlds is an AI-powered learning management system for course creators, training providers, and academies — combining course building, commerce (checkouts, memberships, funnels), community, certificates/SCORM, marketing integrations, and learner analytics.

sections.heading: Who it’s for
sections.body:
• Course creators and coaches selling online courses and memberships
• Training providers running multi-client academies
• Teams needing LMS + commerce + light marketing in one stack

sections.heading: Pricing
sections.body: Starter from $29/mo ($24 annual) with $5/enrollment; Pro Trainer $99 ($79 annual) no enrollment fees; Learning Center $299 ($249 annual); Corporate custom. 30-day trial. Prices exclude VAT. Confirm on learnworlds.com/pricing/.

sections.heading: Key features
sections.body:
• AI course builder, quizzes, and interactive video
• Course commerce: checkouts, memberships, bundles
• Page funnels and landing pages
• Community, certificates, SCORM
• Live sessions via Zoom/Meet/Teams/Webex
• Learner and sales analytics

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.body:
• Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment
• Active learner and admin caps by plan
• AI credits are metered monthly
• Not a social scheduling or listening platform
• Email marketing is credit-capped mass email, not a full ESP

sections.heading: Alternatives
sections.body: Compare Kartra for broader creator funnels/email/SMS all-in-one, Freshmarketer for Freshworks marketing automation, and SocialBee if social scheduling is the primary need.
